meta.title: Koshary Corner — Strategy Brief v2 (owner-first, Arabic)
meta.description: Owner-first strategy-v2 brief. The owner chooses channels before generation; no channel is added or replaced on their behalf. Facebook is set up later, Instagram and Google Business Profile are owner-managed existing presences.
meta.scenario: Owner wants to attract more lunch customers from nearby offices with a small marketing budget and limited weekly time.
